thread:
marta: Quick q — when an upstream scales down midstream should gateway try a midstream resume? Abort/restart is terrible. Thoughts?

alex: Interested but must be gated to idempotent/output-only routes. Checkpoints are risky for PII.

sam: Sketch: runtime emits small base64 checkpoints every N tokens. Gateway stores encrypted handle TTL=30s. On failover we hand checkpoint to warm upstream. Header example: X-RW-Resume-ID: rsm_xxx

marta: Ops constraints: short TTL, KMS encryption, trace propagation, per-tenant cap.

ops-bot: Deploy note: resume prototype merged to staging. Flag edge.resume_enabled=false.

leo: Security: require runtime annotation resume:allowed or client opt-in. Also threat model required.

alex: Also tag resumed responses in telemetry/billing. Trailers ideal but use header fallback.

marta: Plan: phase1 in-memory TTL=30s, phase2 encrypted handles for cross-AZ, phase3 metrics. I'll draft RFC and tag eng-runtime/security/product. No objections?

sam: :thumbsup: add Resume-Accepted trailer and metrics resume.attempts/successes/tokens_saved.

leo: Will do security review once RFC up.
